subject: Security exhibit playbook: scope, pen-test window & evidence cadence (proposal)
messages:
From: Megan Liu <megan.liu@healthco.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@healthco.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Security exhibit — SOC 2 + pen-test window questions for MSA/order form

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement and security at HealthCo are aligning on the MSA/order form and we have a few follow-ups before we can move to signature:

- SOC 2: can you confirm frequency of report sharing and whether Redwood will provide a bridge letter if the most recent report is >90 days old?
- Pen test / inspection: we need a clear statement on what notice HealthCo must provide, whether testing is allowed on production, and any staging requirements.
- Audit rights / evidence cadence: we typically ask for a weekly evidence shipment during onboarding (tickets, configuration screenshots) and quarterly thereafter — would that fit your model, or do you have a prior playbook we can align to?

I've attached our security questionnaire (HealthCo_Security_Questionnaire_v2.pdf) with the specific items pulled out. Happy to hop on a call if easier.

Best,
Megan Liu
Security Manager, HealthCo
megan.liu@healthco.com
(415) 555-0123
(Attachment: HealthCo_Security_Questionnaire_v2.pdf)

Team — forwarding HealthCo's note. Key asks: SOC 2 report cadence/bridge letter, pen-test notice + prod/staging policy, evidence cadence for onboarding/quarterly.

As context: Sales discussed a short onboarding evidence burst (1–2 weeks) and then quarterly attestations with the customer. They are leaning toward weekly evidence during the initial ramp which might be heavy. Procurement also cares about whether pen tests can hit production or only staging.

Can legal/compliance propose specific redlines or standard language we can share back? Also: what can we commit to in the order form vs MSA? HealthCo wants this resolved before countersign.

Thanks — I can coordinate the reply and offer a couple of tentative pen-test windows.

—Karthik

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Nov 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Security exhibit — SOC 2 + pen-test window questions for MSA/order form

Karthik / team,

Thanks for the forward. High-level legal guidance and proposed language below — this is intentionally conservative for procurement but keeps us operationally feasible. I'll attach a short redline and a pen-test window table.

Summary of recommended positions:
- SOC 2: commit to providing the most recent SOC 2 Type II report under NDA within 30 days of request; for reports older than 90 days, offer a bridge letter summarizing mitigations and an estimated date for the next audit. (Order form: \"Customer entitled to receive latest SOC 2 report within 30 days upon execution of an NDA.\")
- Audit rights / inspection: propose a bounded inspection clause: no more than 2 inspection events per 12-month period, each limited to 3 business days, with a minimum 10 business days advance notice; inspections to be performed on non-production systems unless specifically agreed and with written scope. For limited on-prem/air-gapped customers we can discuss alternatives.
- Pen testing: allow customer-led pen tests against staging environments by default; production testing only with explicit approval, timeboxed windows, and a mutually agreed test plan and rollback procedure. Suggest adding an order-form checkbox to opt-in for production tests and define a 30–90 day window scheduling matrix in a separate appendix (see pen-test-window-table.xlsx).
- Evidence cadence: accept a one-week onboarding evidence bundle (tickets, architecture diagrams, scoped logs) followed by quarterly evidence deliveries. If HealthCo insists on weekly evidence post-onboard, propose a time-limited pilot (4 weeks) subject to resourcing fees.

Attachments (drafts I've prepared): redlines_MSA_v1.docx (legal redline of the audit rights and pen-test clauses) and pen-test-window-table.xlsx (proposed scheduling matrix we can share with Ops).

Timing: I can finalize redlines if you want to present a concrete offer to HealthCo by EOD Tuesday 11/16. If Sales prefers a softer language first, I can prepare a short \"we will work with you\" version for the order form.

Let me know which path: firm redline now, or soft-commit then legal follow-up.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com | (415) 555-0137
(Attachments: redlines_MSA_v1.docx, pen-test-window-table.xlsx)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Megan Liu <megan.liu@healthco.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@healthco.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security exhibit — SOC 2 + pen-test window questions for MSA/order form

Megan / Tom — thanks for the clear list. Looping in our legal and compliance folks (cc'd) and proposing the following near-term plan so we can keep the signature timeline: 

1) SOC 2: we will provide the latest SOC 2 Type II under NDA within 30 days. If the report is older than 90 days we'll include a bridge letter.
2) Pen test: default allowed against staging only. Production testing can be arranged if HealthCo completes a test plan and we mutually agree on a 3-day window; Redwood requires min 10 business days notice for production tests.
3) Audit/evidence cadence: we can do a one-week onboarding evidence package (architecture diagram, sample logs, ticket exports) and quarterly follow-ups. If you need weekly evidence after onboarding, we can run a 4-week pilot (resourcing fee applies) — Laura has a short redline and the scheduling matrix attached to this thread.

Proposed next steps: pick any two preferred windows from the pen-test scheduling matrix and we will assign an Ops owner to confirm availability. If that works, I will share an updated order form (DocuSign link below) that explicitly calls out the staged pen-test opt-in and SOC 2 deliverable.

DocuSign (updated order form draft): https://www.docusign.com/fake-envelope/HC-2027-011
Shared draft redlines (internal): https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link/draft-redlines

If you prefer, we can set a 30-minute call to finalize dates tomorrow or Wednesday.

Cheers,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | (650) 555-0199

Karthik / Megan,

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the clarity. The proposed positions are reasonable. Two items:

- HealthCo prefers a 30-day lookback on SOC 2 availability (we can sign an NDA immediately). The bridge letter approach is acceptable for now.
- For the pen-test we'd like two tentative windows in December: Dec 6–8 or Dec 13–15 (staging). If those are feasible we can lock dates and share a short test plan.

Let's schedule a 30-min sync Wednesday to iron out the DocuSign and the order-form checkbox language. If you can share the redline before the call that would be ideal.

Thanks,
Tom Alvarez
Sr. Procurement Manager, HealthCo
tom.alvarez@healthco.com | (206) 555-0177
